lines.text: Through the door, I can't hear any sounds coming from the wards.
I get a bad feeling in the pit of my stomach.
I suddenly think about Cinderella, Siren, Grave, and Crown.
I imagine Rapi, Anis, and Neon lying in the same condition.
My hands are shaking. I don't think I can open the door.
If I open the door to find them in that state...

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Anis, pass me a snack.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Come on, you promised. You were only gonna call for me once every five minutes.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Everyone experiences the passage of time differently.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Can we turn up the music?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Just how much louder do you want it? We won't be able to talk over it.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: But it's T.T. STAR. Do you not want to listen to it because you left the group?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: No, it's nothing like that...

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Then turn up the volume. Oh, but you don't have to turn up the Noise or... Aria.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Haha.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Wow, you're so funny.
The T.T. STAR song plays more loudly through the door.
Thank goodness they're all safe. They seem to be full of energy.
I open the door with a sense of relief and joy.
*Whirr*
Rapi, Anis, Neon.
I'm so glad you're all...
Rapi is covered in casts
and fitted with several iron supports.
Rapi...

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... Commander.
Anis's upper body is wrapped tightly in bandages.
She's missing an arm. It's not a trick of perspective. Her arm is gone.
Anis...

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: ... Commander.
Neon's head and eyes are wrapped in bandages.
She's turned toward me, but the direction of her gaze is slightly off.
... Neon.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Master.
You're... all so... hurt...!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Wh-what?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: M-Master, are you crying?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Anis, hurry. Wipe his tears.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: But only do that. Don't try to gaze into his eyes and comfort him.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Hang on. Ugh, these tissues are stuck.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Anis, Anis! Take a picture! Quick! I wanna see too!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Let me get this dang tissue out first! Argh, even grabbing a tissue is such a pain with one arm!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Actually, I believe taking a picture is higher priority. Change of plan.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Oh come on...! You both have hands and feet!

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: In case you missed it, I'm missing an entire hand!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I can't move.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: And I can't see.
Still, I'm just so...
I'm so glad... you're safe...!
I'm so happy... you're alive...!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Is no one taking a picture?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: You really think now's the time?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Maybe not.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Commander, we're glad to see you safe too.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I'm so glad you're alive.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Yeah... I'm glad too, Master!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Just like Absolute, we asked to be deprioritized since we're all at least still alive.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Now we're just waiting here until it's our turn.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Not that I have much choice, since I can't move my body at all.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: They even took my phone so I could get rest.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: That's why I couldn't contact you sooner. I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... I would've died if not for the gene. I was lucky I could recover quickly enough to survive.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I barely made it. The gene stopped working after the battle.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... I guess that means she's no longer a Queen at all now.
It sounds like the gene isn't only given to just humans.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Right. It doesn't seem to care who receives it.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I suppose there's a chance that even a complete machine could possess the gene.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... Though there's no way to find out now.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Right. The Queen is dead, and Marian chose the Commander.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: By the way, is your gene still active, Commander?
It feels like less than before.
I think the black moon is made of such concentrated Dark Matter that my contact with Marian has been cut off.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Still, I'm glad your ties to Marian haven't disappeared completely.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: There's something I thought of when I was face-to-face with death.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: It was your smile and your voice. They gave me the strength to—

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Before you guys go off on a tangent, let me tell you how I'm doing.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: ... I mean, you can kinda tell just by looking.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: I lost an entire arm.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: But at least I'm the most intact of anyone here. I can still walk around and use my other hand.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Anis. Water.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Anis. Snack.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: That's why I'm acting as their errand girl.
That can't be easy.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: It's just how it goes. Since I'm in the best shape, I have to do all the moving around.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Also, there's something we all really realized.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: We don't have bodies that can just be remade with a body maker anymore.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Rapi has a fused core and no NIMPH, so it's not an option for her, and my core has been fused with STAR too, so not an option for me either.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: And Neon's body was made with some kind of lost technology.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Our only option is to have our current bodies repaired.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: They say we might suffer some aftereffects from that.
Aftereffects?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Yeah, but I'm sure it'll be fine. Science is always getting better, right?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Yep, yep.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Oh, apparently I got hit so hard in the head that my ocular parts are all messed up.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: They said it was really dangerous, since I got hit straight to the face.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: But given that I have the healthiest body around, I only suffered a little damage to my eyes.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Did you know, Master?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: There's more to the world than just seeing with your eyes.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: There are realms that can't be reached precisely because they can't be seen.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: I shall explore those realms until I am reborn as Neo-Neo-Neon.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: I never know what she's talking about.
I'm just glad you look so healthy.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Yeah. I can't tell you how happy I am that none of us died.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Let's get better soon so we can get going.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Yeah. I'm gonna heal right up and then head out.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I'd like to hurry, but I'm not sure I can like this.
Hang on. Where are you rushing to go?

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Where do you think?

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Obviously to go save Marian.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: It's Operation Save the Princess.
But... how...?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Not sure. We'll have to think it over carefully.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Yeah. We have way more questions than answers, but we'll figure something out.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Exactly. She must be so lonely all by herself in a place like that.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Honestly, it's so far beyond normal reality that I don't understand it all,

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: but what I do know is that Marian is alone in that black moon.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: So we've got to get her out of there.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Yeah, for sure.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: She may have grown up a bit, but she's still the baby of our group.
Yeah...
We have to get her out.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Anis.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Oh, right.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Commander, there's this big flat area behind the Outpost.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: The Wings of Victory and everyone from the Goddess Squad are all there.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Go say hi to them. We'll just be waiting here.
Oh, okay. I'll go see them then.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Go right now.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: We're about to get a check-up, so we're gonna have to strip down.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Eek, I'm so embarrassed.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: If you want to stay, I won't try to stop you.
Oh, uh, okay. I'll just go right now, then.
Get some rest. Keep up the good work just a while longer, Anis. I'll take care of everyone when I get back.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Oh, I can't wait.
I'll be back.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Yeah. See you soon.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Bring me back a soda.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Bring me back a cloth for my glasses.
Will do.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: ... He's gone, right?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Yeah, I can't hear his footsteps anymore.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: I confirmed it with my mind's eye. He's gone.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Argh...!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Agh... An...is... I'm sorry, but I need... painkiller.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Urgh... Okay...

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: This hurts... so bad! Turning off my pain sensors... does nothing!

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: By the way, I've been wondering. Are my eyes on fire?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: No...

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Oh good. I was worried because it feels like they are.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: You don't think... he noticed... right?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: No. I'm sure... he didn't.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: I was so surprised when he started crying. I've never seen a man cry before. Well, I guess technically I still haven't.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: No kidding. He must've been so worried about us. Ugh, he almost made me start crying too.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: You all... did great. Good teamwork.

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: We've grown so in tune with each other.

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Well, yeah, after spending this much time together.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: This hurts...

lines.speaker: anis_i_w
lines.text: Yeah... I feel like I'm dying...

lines.speaker: neon_v_w
lines.text: Are you sure my eyes aren't on fire? Really?
